title: Course Management Play To Your Strengths (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl steel guitar
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, dont play the hero shot
Play the percentage shot, take what the course gives
Course management is half the score

[Verse 1]
Fairway over distance every time, son
Position over power, the smart game won
Pin tucked behind a hazard, aim for fat of green
Thirty feet from the pin beats the bunker scene

[Pre-Chorus]
Know your stock yardages, club up if uncertain
Wind in the face, take two more curtain
Wind at the back, take one less
Temperature, elevation, factor in the press

[Chorus]
Course management play to your strengths, son
Percentage shots, every single one
Fat of the green, middle of the fairway
Take the easy path, win the doorway

[Verse 2]
Par three pins on the front, club for the back
Par four tee shot, find the wide track
Par five second shot, lay up to your number
Ninety yards full wedge, the easiest slumber

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, ego is the score killer
The pros aim away from the trouble, the smart driller
Take bogey out of play first
Then birdie chances find their burst

[Chorus]
Course management play to your strengths, son
Percentage shots, every single one
Fat of the green, middle of the fairway
Take the easy path, win the doorway

[Outro]
Fairway first, position second
Fat of the green, the smart way reckoned
No hero shots, no ego plays
Thats my boy, thats the way
